svg.text: Typeface: League Spartan ExtraBold (SIL Open Font License 1.1, free for commercial use), converted to outlines and then cut. One ink, one pearl, one wax-red accent. None applied yet.
The word sliced through the middle; the halves sit offset like a closed tablet. Below: the opening frame.
tab / ella set as one square block. The wax seal completes the short line.
The last a loses its counter and becomes a lock. Only the right people open it.
The ll become two people standing together, holding the seal between them.
Stencil bridges cut through every letter. One gap keeps a fragment of the red seal.
The first a is closed with wax, the last a stands open. The tagline, told by two letters.
League Spartan: Copyright 2020 The League Spartan Project Authors (github.com/theleagueof/league-spartan). Outlines modified; the name is not used for the modified letters.
